services.name: Rock "n" Roll Ride & Rappel in Rock Canyon
services.desc: Embark on an adventure of a lifetime with our most extreme tour! Kickstart your day at the breathtaking Coral Pink Sand Dunes State Park, where the thrill begins. For just a $10 entrance fee, unlock the gateway to a day packed with excitement. Hop aboard our rugged UTVs for a beautiful journey to the iconic Rock Canyon Trailhead. Prepare to test your limits as you conquer Rock Canyon with rappels ranging from 10 to 110 feet. Cross the serene Virgin River to discover ancient Petroglyphs, adding a touch of history to your adventure. services.name: The Huntress Half Day Rappel
services.desc: This canyon is well-known for its beauty and is the perfect place to experience rappelling for the first time! Duration 4 to 5 hours About Take a guided hiking and rappelling tour with our professionally trained and experienced guides through the area's most popular slot canyon "The Huntress" with a hike in, hike out series of 4 rappels. It begins with a small rappel which allows newcomers to get their first taste and "learn the ropes". From there, the canyon drops down into larger slot canyons with some intermediate rappels as you wind through the beautiful sandstone walls.
